# Planloo

> Planloo is an all-in-one event planning platform for individuals and teams. It covers every stage of event organisation — from initial planning through to execution on the day.

## What is Planloo?

Planloo is a web-based SaaS application that helps people plan events of any size. It replaces scattered spreadsheets and email threads with a single workspace where the entire event — guests, budget, tasks, vendors, and seating — is managed in one place. A free plan is available with no credit card required.

## Core Features

- **Guest Management**: Import guests from CSV or add them manually. Send personalised invitation links, collect RSVPs automatically, track dietary requirements and attendance status.
- **Budget Tracking**: Set an overall budget, log expenses against categories, record vendor payments, and monitor remaining funds with real-time charts.
- **Task Tracking**: Create checklists, assign tasks to collaborators, set due dates, and track completion progress as the event approaches.
- **Seating Planner**: Drag-and-drop floor plan editor with support for custom table shapes. Seat guests and detect conflicts in real time. Scales from 10 to 1,000+ guests.
- **Team Collaboration**: Invite co-planners, assign roles, and work simultaneously on the same event. Full audit trail shows who changed what and when.
- **Vendor Directory**: Browse and save caterers, venues, photographers, florists, and other service providers. Store contracts, reviews, pricing, and contact details.

## Pricing

Planloo offers a free tier with no credit card required. Paid plans unlock higher guest limits, additional events, priority support, and team collaboration features. See https://planloo.com/#pricing for current pricing.

## Who is it for?

- Individual event hosts planning weddings, birthday parties, corporate events, or private gatherings
- Professional event planners managing multiple clients
- Teams and organisations running internal or public-facing events

## Technical Details

- Web application, accessible from any browser on desktop or mobile
- No software installation required
- Data is stored securely in the cloud

## Supported Event Types

Planloo supports 14 event types:

- Wedding
- Birthday Party
- Corporate Event
- Conference
- Holiday Party
- Engagement Party
- Fundraiser
- Anniversary
- Graduation
- Retirement Party

- Bridal Shower
- Themed Party
- Celebration of Life
